title: Maximum Product of the Length of Two Palindromic Substrings
summary: Given a string, find two non-overlapping palindromic substrings of odd length with the highest product of their lengths.
statement: Given a string, find two non-overlapping palindromic substrings of odd length with the highest product of their lengths. Choose indices i, j, k, l such that 0 <= i <= j < k <= l < s.length, and both s[i...j] and s[k...l] are palindromes with odd lengths. Return the maximum product of these lengths.
constraints: s has 2 through 100000 lowercase English letters.
Choose two nonoverlapping substrings in left-to-right order.
Both palindromes must have odd positive length; maximize the product of their lengths.
hints: Odd Manacher radii give every center's longest palindrome; shorter nested palindromes propagate two characters at a time toward earlier ends and later starts.
Build the best palindrome contained in every prefix and suffix, then test each split between adjacent characters.
Compute radii; seed exact end/start lengths; propagate nested lengths and prefix/suffix maxima; maximize left[i]*right[i+1].
Every candidate pair is separated by some split. The propagated arrays store the longest legal palindrome on each side of every split, so their product dominates every pair and is itself attainable.

tests.explanation: Choose aba of length three and bbb of length three for product nine.
The nonoverlapping aaa and bbb palindromes give product nine.
